# Getting help

- Installation and usage: read the [getting-started guide](../docs/public/README.md).
- Reproducible bugs and feature requests: open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/madcodeorg/nota/issues/new/choose). Include the release version, operating system, architecture and steps to reproduce. Remove personal workspace content and credentials from logs first.
- Security vulnerabilities: report privately through [security advisories](https://github.com/madcodeorg/nota/security/advisories/new), not public issues. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Nota is a community project with no guaranteed response time.
